gags.description: Browser maps page: a numbered 'Turn left' step pops in on each beat of bar 60 while the pin loops four lefts back to its start; the camera cuts on every beat, turning further left each time
'snack lab' window: two flasks holding snack packs A and B, a beating heart between them, a CHEMISTRY meter filling one segment per beat to 100%
'Calendar (hostile)': event chips (MEETING, DENTIST, TAXES...) with angry eyebrows and little legs march left across the month on eighth notes. Brief callback, not counted as a new gag

'Royal Laundry Museum': a crowned laundry basket (LAUNDRY V) sits on a throne on a pink carpet under a HOUSE OF LAUNDRY banner, flanked by framed portraits of crowned ancestor piles LAUNDRY I to IV; wide for 2 beats, then cuts to the portraits and the throne with a confetti pop
Four 'wait, what?' dialogs (Why did you open this window? / You walked in here for something. / It was important. Probably. / Wait. What?) stack diagonally, one per beat, buttons Wait and What?

mirror.app, camera locked and centred: a butterfly, sun and plants drawn in full colour on the left half; the mirrored right half is only dashed pencil outline with TODO labels, the SYMMETRY bar stops at 50% and the pencil says 'brb'

A thought bubble above the glovebox icon labelled MENTAL TROPHY SHELF: tiny trophies with labels (drank water, found keys, sent it...) drop in one per beat, then one per eighth note in bar 67, stacking into a swaying tower; a WINS counter counts up; the camera climbs the tower and pulls back wide
Same gag as br.07: the tower stacks on eighth notes and sways; not counted separately

notes: Cuts on every beat (two beats on the laundry wide shot, four on the locked mirror shot), small zoom punch per cut, no whips. The browser (VERSE_WINDOW, tabCountAt = 96 slivers) is always in the world behind the app windows. br.01 is grid-timed: the local lyric card gives 'I got' the two pickup beats of bar 59 and lands 'left-turn' on the bar 60 downbeat. Lyric cards: paper for ambient lines, mustard for gag lines, lower-left (centred on the mirror shot). Last frame 3510 is a wide shot of the full tower; hard cut into verse 3 on the bar 68 downbeat.
